## Locked Architecture Decisions

| # | Topic | Locked decision |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Tier 3 "never store" conflict | **A+B combine** — feature-flag `M050_BRK_PERSIST_ENABLED=false` (default) gates writes tot Kadaster DPA signed + DB CHECK constraint `eigenaar_type IN ('rechtspersoon', 'overheid')` enforce't AVG defense-in-depth. Pydantic `never_cache` marker blijft als 3e laag. |
| D2 | `raw_brk_response` JSONB | **Strip-at-write** — service-layer helper `strip_raw_brk_response()` redact natuurlijke personen vóór JSONB insert. Debugging-waarde behouden voor rechtspersoon/overheid. |
| D3 | Soft-delete trigger | **B+C** — service-layer (`parcel_favorites_service.delete()` zet `soft_deleted_at` expliciet, primair pad) + daily ARQ orphan-detection cron als safety-net voor bypassed paths. |
| D4 | Feature-flag scope | **Write-path only** — migratie loopt onbelemmerd, schema bestaat altijd. Service-layer `persist_record()` raise't `FeatureDisabled` als flag=false. Read-path werkt. |
| D5 | UNIQUE (org, parcel, fetched_at) | **Historie bewust** — multiple rows per (org, parcel) over tijd. Voedt S03 `koopwaarde_trend` factor. Retention-cron deletes alleen wanneer ALLE rows voor (org, parcel) soft_deleted + expired. |
| D6 | Hard-delete observability | **Structured-log + Sentry alert >1000 deletes/run** — `brk.retention.cleanup` event met `deleted_count`. Sentry-rule fires bij anomaly threshold. |
| D7 | Service-file naming | **`brk_persistence_service.py`** (matcht milestone-plan, NIET split) — S01 vult retention-deel + stubs voor persist-write die S02 implementeert. |
| D8 | `eigenaar_naam` nullability | **TEXT NULL toegestaan + service-layer reject NULL bij rechtspersoon** — DB matcht Pydantic `naam: str | None`, app-laag enforce't business-rule. Robust tegen incomplete BRK-data. |

## Datamodel (LOCKED)

```sql
CREATE TABLE brk_ownership_records (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  organization_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  parcel_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,                 -- BAG-style ID
  eigenaar_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,             -- 'rechtspersoon' | 'overheid'
  eigenaar_naam TEXT,                             -- NULL toegestaan (D8)
  kvk_nummer VARCHAR(8),
  statutaire_zetel TEXT,
  zakelijk_recht_type VARCHAR(32),
  aandeel TEXT,
  koopsom NUMERIC,
  koopjaar INTEGER,
  heeft_hypotheek BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  raw_brk_response JSONB,                         -- strip-at-write (D2)
  fetched_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  soft_deleted_at TIMESTAMP,
  hard_delete_after TIMESTAMP,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT eigenaar_type_check
    CHECK (eigenaar_type IN ('rechtspersoon', 'overheid')),   -- D1 defense
  UNIQUE (organization_id, parcel_id, fetched_at)              -- D5 historie
);
CREATE INDEX idx_brk_org_parcel ON brk_ownership_records (organization_id, parcel_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_brk_hard_delete ON brk_ownership_records (hard_delete_after)
  WHERE soft_deleted_at IS NOT NULL;
```

**Retention math (Q7 LOCKED):**
- `unfavorite` → `soft_deleted_at = NOW()`, `hard_delete_after = NOW() + 60 days`
- 30d soft window: re-favorite within window skips re-fetch
- 90d total (30 soft + 60 hard): cron hard-deletes row

## Service-layer architectuur

```
app/services/
└── brk_persistence_service.py   # D7: persist + retention (S01 stubs persist-write voor S02)
    ├── strip_raw_brk_response(raw: dict) -> dict       # D2
    ├── persist_record(brk_data, org_id) -> Record       # D1 FF gate + D8 naam reject + D2 strip
    ├── soft_delete_for_org_parcel(org_id, parcel_id)    # D3 primary trigger
    ├── find_orphaned_records() -> list[UUID]            # D3 safety-net query
    └── (S02 zal toevoegen: fetch_and_persist, get_latest_for_parcel)

app/jobs/
└── brk_retention_cleanup_job.py # daily cron, hard-delete + orphan-pickup
    ├── hard_delete_expired() -> int        # delete waar hard_delete_after < NOW
    ├── soft_delete_orphans() -> int        # safety-net D3
    └── alert_if_anomaly(count: int)        # Sentry >1000 (D6)

app/api/endpoints/
└── (S01: geen endpoints — pure data-laag)

app/config.py
└── M050_BRK_PERSIST_ENABLED: bool = False  # D4 default disabled
```

---

## Retention state-machine

```
[live record]
   │
   │ parcel_favorites_service.delete() (D3 primary)
   │ ── of orphan-cron pickt up (D3 safety)
   ▼
[soft_deleted_at = NOW()]
[hard_delete_after = NOW() + 60d]
   │
   │ +30d window: re-favorite skips re-fetch (re-use existing record)
   │ +60d window: cron does NOT delete yet
   ▼
[hard_delete_after < NOW()] ──daily cron──► DELETE row
                                            (Sentry alert if count >1000, D6)
```

## Worktree parallelization strategy

**Sequential implementation, no parallelization opportunity** binnen S01 zelf — alle 8 deliverables raken hetzelfde module-cluster (`app/models/`, `app/services/`, `app/jobs/`, migrations). Slice is foundation-only en dependencies tussen artifacts vereisen ordered build.

**Build order:**
1. Migration (zc_*.py) + Model (brk_ownership_record.py) parallel — 30 min
2. Service stubs + tests — 1u
3. ARQ job + tests — 30 min
4. `parcel_favorites_service` D3 wiring + regression tests — 45 min
5. Config flag + integration tests — 30 min
6. Multi-tenant isolation E2E test — 45 min

**Total estimate:** ~4u single-developer (with CC). Geen worktree-parallel.

**M050 lane-context (downstream):** S01 = Lane B foundation. S02 + S03 (zelfde lane B) wachten op S01 merge. Lane C (S04/S04.5) en Lane A (M050.5) kunnen parallel beginnen — geen S01-dependency.

## Migration naming convention (nieuw — start vanaf M050/S01)

**Oud:** 2-char alphabetic prefix (`a0`...`z0`, `za`, `zb`). Liep tegen alphabetic-ceiling aan (24 slots over na `zb`).

**Nieuw vanaf 2026-05-18:** `YYYYMMDD_<slice>_<descriptor>.py`
- Voorbeeld: `20260518_m050_s01_create_brk_ownership_records.py`
- Same-day collision: append `_<idx>` (`20260518_m050_s01_..._1.py`, `..._2.py`)
- **Bestaande migraties NIET renamen** — Alembic chain't via `revision` / `down_revision` velden, prefix is cosmetisch. Renames zouden alleen ruis veroorzaken zonder waarde.

**Migrate-rule (TODO post-S01):** korte note in `backend/alembic/README.md` of CLAUDE.md zodat reviewer weet waarom S01+ er anders uitziet dan oudere migraties.
